api_contracts.purpose: Authenticate and freshness-check a typed remote command before local policy evaluation.
api_contracts.mutation: Records nonce only after signature and time checks pass.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fail closed on malformed expired future-issued overlong invalid-signature or replayed envelopes.

api_contracts.purpose: Route automatically allowed structured capabilities to bounded local executors.
api_contracts.mutation: Automatic dispatch remains read-only; mutating or execution capabilities stop at approval-required.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown and shell capabilities deny; write patch process and clone return approval-required before side effects.

api_contracts.purpose: Register or reconnect an outbound device and rotate its short-lived relay session token.
api_contracts.mutation: Replaces the active in-memory session token hash for the device.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid device IDs or bad registration credentials fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Queue a bounded command for a known device.
api_contracts.mutation: Adds one request to the bounded per-device queue.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown devices duplicate request IDs and full queues reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Long-poll the next available command from an outbound device connection.
api_contracts.mutation: Leases a command for bounded time; it remains eligible for redelivery after lease expiry until a result is submitted.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Expired rotated or cross-device session tokens reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Submit a result for a request owned by the authenticated device.
api_contracts.mutation: Completes the queued request and stores a bounded retained result.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown requests and cross-device submissions reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Stream the completed result as one SSE event.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown requests reject and waits time out without fabricating results.

data_contracts.name: Workspace root
invariants: Filesystem operations are relative to os.Root and cannot resolve outside it through lexical or symlink traversal.
Process working directory is the trusted workspace root.

data_contracts.name: Capability authorization
invariants: filesystem.read filesystem.list git.status and git.diff may auto-execute.
filesystem.write filesystem.patch process.run and git.clone require trusted local approval.
shell.exec powershell.exec bash.exec and unknown capabilities deny by default.
Remote request payloads cannot self-assert trusted approval.

data_contracts.name: Relay device session
data_contracts.retention: Until expiry restart or replacement by reconnect
invariants: Registration and controller bootstrap keys are distinct.
Session token is random and only its hash is stored.
A rotated session invalidates the prior token.
A session token authenticates only its device ID.

data_contracts.name: Relay command queue
invariants: Queue length is bounded per device.
Request IDs are unique while retained.
Leased commands may redeliver after lease expiry until completion.

data_contracts.name: Relay completed results
data_contracts.retention: Bounded by maximum retained result count or relay restart
invariants: Result request must belong to submitting device.
Old completed results are evicted when the configured bound is reached.

data_contracts.name: Active-process nonce replay cache
data_contracts.retention: Until command expiry or process exit
invariants: A deviceID+nonce pair is accepted at most once within one active process before expiry.
Restart-safe replay prevention is not yet implemented.

ui_surfaces.name: Chat client
ui_surfaces.backend_authority: Future paired controller plus relay plus local PC-agent policy result
actions: approve or deny privileged capability requests
forbidden_actions: represent an unverified runtime result as successful
